items.h: Metchie caught two of four targets for 17 yards in Sunday's 20-12 win over the Dolphins in Week 15.
items.s: One of Metchie's four targets was an incompletion in the red zone. He's been the most productive of the Texans' depth wideouts behind Nico Collins and Tank Dell, but the Houston passing game in 2024 is not what it was in 2023. Metchie has 17 receptions on 25 targets for 182 yards over 11 appearances this season.
